multi_transform_with_state: transform a collection of Haiku functions into pure init and apply functions with state support
multi_transform: transform a collection of Haiku functions sharing modules into pure init and apply functions without state
without_state: convert a MultiTransformedWithState object to a MultiTransformed object by stripping state from init and apply
without_apply_rng: remove the rng argument from a transformed Haiku apply function by defaulting it to None
make_tree: reconstruct a JAX PyTree by mapping a function over leaf indices and unflattening with a treedef
